requirements.text: 1+ years of professional experience writing production-grade code in Python and querying complex datasets using SQL.
1+ years of professional experience building, validating, and deploying machine learning models, statistical models, algorithmic solutions, or LLM-based solutions.
Experience using Git/GitHub for version control and collaborative code development.
Experience delivering presentations, reports, or business reviews to cross-functional stakeholders.
Initiative: Proven ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, interview process owners, and structure solutions rather than waiting for defined specifications.
Stakeholder Communication: Ability to translate complex data science concepts into clear business risks and opportunities for non-technical partners.
ML Model & Generative AI: Practical experience building ML solutions or LLM-based solutions (e.g., prompt design, RAG architectures, model evaluation frameworks).
Production Monitoring: Experience establishing model performance guardrails, such as drift detection, production monitoring, and alerting systems.
Domain Experience: Familiarity with healthcare data (e.g., pharmacy claims, clinical workflows, or unstructured clinical notes).
Cloud & Tools: Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar enterprise cloud environments, as well as AI-assisted software development tools.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
Master's degree in a quantitative field or MBA strongly preferred.
